messages:
Ivy: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp failing on rerank. Staging logs: 400 Embedding shape mismatch: declared 512, got 513.
Tomas: Oof. Any request/response dump?
Ivy: Sanitized payload shows both keys: {\"embedding\": {\"dim\":512, \"embedding_length\":513, \"values\": [...]}}. Server picked embedding_length and validated against it.
Ellen: Wait, we added embedding_length in the Go batcher to optimize routing a while back. It was set from a pre-allocated buffer capacity, not the final slice len. If we resliced after append the header could be stale.
Tomas: Python sample sets dim = len(values). So two competing fields.
Ivy: Also saw a 401 -> refresh -> retry sequence in the traces. The retry sent the same conflicting metadata, so retry not creating new corruption here. But the intermittent reslice race might make header wrong sometimes.
Ellen: Short-term: patch sampleapp.go to stop emitting embedding_length header and only set dim in the payload. Longer-term: server should canonicalize dim = len(values) and ignore client-provided length fields.
Tomas: Agree. Server change should return a clear error when mismatch occurs, e.g. \"declared length X != actual len Y\" instead of generic mismatch. Saves time for devs.
ci-bot: Created ticket INF-4392: "embedding metadata parity: embedding_length vs dim" and queued a small server patch job.
sdk-bot: Filed INF-4393 to update go-sdk: remove embedding_length header, compute header only after serialization if we keep it. Tagging python-sdk for docs alignment.
Ellen: Also found a potential micro-bug: go-batcher mutates a shared slice when batching; if a reslice/truncation happens after header set but before send, header may be wrong. Fix is to clone the slice or set header after finalize.
Tomas: For python-sdk, add preflight check: coerce arrays to np.float32 and assert len(values) == declared dim if present, or drop declared dim. Also call np.nan_to_num to avoid nulls in JSON.
Ivy: I'll push a temp sampleapp hotfix to stop sending embedding_length so QA can continue.
Ellen: Deploy-bot — canary the server-side guard that ignores embedding_length and validates against len(values)?
deploy-bot: Canary updated: pipeline #7012 includes shape-validate middleware and improved error responses.
Tomas: Add an E2E in devex harness that runs Go+Python sampleapps in parallel and fails on any parity mismatch; also add a unit that simulates reslice races to the go-sdk CI.
Ivy: Good call — I'll add the repro case to the sampleapp tests.
Ellen: One more DX improvement: document canonical field name (dim) in the SDK CONTRIBUTING guide and add a small linter rule in go-sdk that prevents adding competing metadata keys.
Tomas: After server guard lands and we remove header, we should backfill a migration note for customers who may have been relying on X-Embedding-Length for routing.
Ivy: Thanks everyone — ping me if you want to pair on the repro or tests. :thumbsup:
Tomas: Nice triage. We'll follow-up on PR links here when ready.
